subject: Call functions after another one is finished

messages.author: f8b7c6eae8e5aa1d
messages.subject: Call functions after another one is finished
parts:
Hi,

Is there a way to call a function only after another one has finished its rendering ?

I mean, I got something like :

observe({
input$something
renderPlot(...)
doSomething()
})

But I absolutely need this doSomething() to happen after renderPlot(...) is done.
I know it's kind of against the logic of using asynchronous, and this logic is really great for my whole apps, except for one little thing (I need to call a js init() function after a page has been loaded).

Any idea how I could achieve this ?

Thanks

Robin
